name: SixSeven & Prism Tokens
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 1.00). Replaced keyword guess "accounting-math".
rootCause: The SixSeven and Prism token contracts on BNB Smart Chain contained a business logic vulnerability in their core token or liquidity mechanics. The attacker exploited a flaw in the protocol's accounting or reward distribution logic — consistent with the BlockSec rootCauseLabel of 'Business Logic Flaw' — to manipulate the contract's internal state and extract approximately $193,000 in value. No public post-mortem or detailed security analysis of this specific incident was identified, limiting the reconstruction of the precise attack vector. Attack Tx: 0xcf7cacfe38dcf090bbfcc91634de364e62ef3715fdc8d6f69e855772b0862237
